title: Linux Admin/ Linux System Admin | SNDK CORP
description:
Full Time

Ahmedabad

**Job Summary:**
----------------

We are seeking an experienced Linux Admin/Linux System Admin to join our team. The ideal candidate will have experience in Linux server administration and troubleshooting, and have a passion for working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

**Experience:** 5+ years

### **Required Skills:**

* Strong proficiency in Linux operating system and related tools, including shell scripting and command-line tools.
* Install, configure, and maintain Linux servers, including file servers, application servers, database server, mail server and web servers.
* Participate in the continuous improvement process for refining the architecture, performance and scalability.
* Responsibility for security.
* Experience with network protocols and services, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, SMTP and HTTP/HTTPS.
* Perform daily duties of backups, maintenance on applications and OS, patching, tuning, scripting, automating tasks, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to use a wide variety of open source technologies and cloud services.
* Experience in VOIP server (Asterisk, Freepbx, etc.) will be an added advantage.

If you are a skilled Linux Admin/Linux System Admin looking for a challenging and rewarding career, please submit your application today.
